instana.Application.description: Represents a monitored application perspective in Instana, composed of observable services

instana.Service.description: A discrete observable service surfaced by Instana, derived from Container Workloads in the core model

instana.Latency.description: Latency metric observed for an Instana-monitored application or service

instana.Throughput.description: Throughput metric observed for an Instana-monitored application or service

instana.Synthetics.description: Synthetic monitoring check associated with an Instana Application

instana.Logs.description: Log data emitted by services and workloads monitored by Instana

instana.Metrics.description: General resource and service metrics collected by Instana (covers ResourceMetrics and ServiceMetrics subtypes)

instana.Traces.description: Distributed trace data collected by Instana across services

concert.Application.description: Represents an application managed in Concert, linked to an environment for deployment-scoped governance

concert.Environment.description: A Concert-managed deployment environment scoping applications and access points

concert.AccessPoints.description: Network entry points (endpoints/ingress) scoped to a Concert Environment

concert.SourceCode.description: Source code repository tracked by Concert as input to the software supply chain

concert.CodeRepos.description: Code repository entities managed in Concert representing the source origin of artifacts

concert.CICDPipelines.description: CI/CD pipeline definitions that build and deliver software artifacts from source to deployment

concert.BuildArtifact.description: Executable, config file, or deployable artifact produced by a CI/CD pipeline and tracked by Concert

concert.CVEVulnerability.description: A recorded CVE security vulnerability associated with a Concert image or build artifact

concert.ITSMData.description: ITSM (IT Service Management) records such as change tickets and service requests associated with Concert-managed components

concert.IncidentData.description: Incident records tracked by Concert representing operational disruptions affecting applications

concert.Patch.description: A security or maintenance patch tracked by Concert for remediating CVEs in applications

concert.ResilienceMetrics.description: Computed resilience scores for a Concert application component, aggregated from observability and ITSM data

concert.ResilienceProfile.description: An aggregated resilience profile for a Concert application, summarizing metrics across multiple dimensions

concert.ComplianceApplication.description: A Concert compliance-scoped view of an application, tracking regulatory adherence

concert.ComplianceReports.description: Compliance audit reports generated by Concert for a monitored application or environment

turbonomic.TurboApplication.description: Represents an application entity managed in Turbonomic, composed of services for optimization

turbonomic.ResourceUsages.description: Resource utilization data (CPU, memory, storage) collected by Turbonomic for infrastructure optimization

turbonomic.ServiceMetrics.description: Service-level performance metrics tracked by Turbonomic as input to optimization decisions

turbonomic.OptimizationPolicy.description: A policy in Turbonomic that governs resource optimization decisions based on usage and service metrics

turbonomic.OptimizationAction.description: A recommended or executed infrastructure action generated by Turbonomic to optimize resource utilization

hcp_terraform.TerraformTemplate.description: An Infrastructure-as-Code template (HCL/Terraform configuration) that defines and provisions cloud infrastructure resources

core_infrastructure.ContainerImage.description: A container image in the common data layer, instantiated by Container Workloads and carrying CVE metadata from Concert

core_infrastructure.ContainerWorkload.description: A running container workload (e.g., a Kubernetes Pod deployment) in the core infrastructure model

core_infrastructure.Service.description: A network-accessible service entity in the core infrastructure model, surfaced by container workloads

core_infrastructure.Cluster.description: A Kubernetes or cloud cluster resource in the core infrastructure model

core_infrastructure.Node.description: A compute node within a cluster, hosting Pods and Container Workloads

core_infrastructure.Pod.description: A Kubernetes Pod resource, grouping one or more containers scheduled on a node

core_infrastructure.Namespace.description: A Kubernetes Namespace providing logical isolation within a Cluster

core_infrastructure.Deployment.description: A Kubernetes Deployment resource managing the desired state of Container Workloads

core_infrastructure.Volume.description: A persistent storage volume in the core infrastructure model, provisioned for Container Workloads

core_infrastructure.AccessPoint.description: A network access point (load balancer, ingress rule) exposing services in the core infrastructure model
